answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 7338 Country: India Title: My name is Mohammad Irshad I have a question that what we should write. So Far I am using Mohammad or Mohd whereas if i translate as per Urdu it comes Muhammad. Is it ok to use Mohammad or Mohd or Md. Question: Assalaamuleyikum, My name is Mohammad Irshad I have a question that what we should write. So Far I am using Mohammad or Mohd whereas if i translate as per Urdu it comes Muhammad. Is it ok to use Mohammad or Mohd or Md. Jazaakumulllah! Answer ID: 7338 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1157/1000=L/1429) It is better to write complete محمد with U (like Muhammad) without shortening it. O is used in place of waw ( و ), therefore you had better write U instead of O. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
